Subject: SDK quick update ahead of checkpoint

Hi all — quick status update for tomorrow's sync and a note on a blocker.

SDK status (snapshot):
- Python + Node: sample client, CI tests passing against stubbed runtime
- Java: needs a small adapter for streaming; ETA for adapter: 48–72 hours
- Go: prototype exists but missing retry/backoff for transient token errors

Blocker: our streaming harness fails intermittently with chunked frames > 64KB in the long-conversation test (repro steps in the ticket). I've attached a minimal patch that adds chunked-frame buffering and a fallback to polling for clients that can't accept large frames. Patch: sdk_streaming_patch.diff

Suggested short-term mitigation: enable buffered streaming + polling fallback for Orchid pilot while we harden the streaming handler. This preserves low-latency for most flows and avoids dropping long messages.

I'll walk through the patch in the call and can open a short-lived feature flag to toggle the fallback.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior SDK Engineer — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sdk_streaming_patch.diff (text/plain)]
